state.user_prompt: Summarize the following tweets about Netflix in 5 sentences. Just tell me what normal people think about Netflix; most of these tweets say the same thing anyway, and the odd ones out don’t really represent anyone. Keep it simple.
state.summary: Most people view Netflix as a perfect companion for lazy days, sick recoveries, and relaxing nights at home. Users frequently describe binge-watching entire seasons while wearing comfortable clothes or eating snacks in bed. Many tweets express frustration with technical issues like loading errors or password sharing disputes among friends and partners. Some viewers feel overwhelmed by the vast library, noting that they sometimes watch too much content to know what to pick next. Overall, the general sentiment is that Netflix is an essential source of entertainment for escaping daily stress and boredom.
